## Sit up

**Word Power 23 · Phrasal verbs**

### Meaning

To not go to bed until later than usual, usually reading, writing or waiting for someone.

### Usage

1. We sat up half the night, talking.
2. I sat up until midnight writing letters.
3. She sat up all night with the sick child.

### Your turn

Use “sit up” in a sentence of your own. The original lesson image also includes Hindi support and illustrations.
